headline:
Context budget and Claude Code costs.
Inside your editor.
tagline: Context budgets, Claude Code costs, and secret-file safety for AI coding in VS Code.

features.name: Context budget meter
features.description: Tokens used against the model's window, with a clear breakdown.

features.name: Claude Code tracking
features.description: Turns, cache hits, and API-equivalent cost from your Claude Code logs. Updates on its own.

features.name: Turn analytics
features.description: Growth per turn and turns left before the window fills.

features.name: Tab relevance and cleanup
features.description: Scores every open tab and closes the noise in one click.

features.name: Pinned files
features.description: Keep key files at full relevance.

features.name: Model catalog
features.description: 32 current models with verified prices. Detects your Copilot model.

features.name: Long-context pricing
features.description: Rates switch above each provider's threshold.

features.name: Price watch and catalog sync
features.description: Daily price sync, with alerts when a rate changes.

features.name: Secure Workspace
features.description: Checks every secret file is hidden from agents, fixes gaps, and verifies.

features.name: Instruction file audit
features.description: Shows which instruction files load into every prompt and their cost.

features.name: Generators
features.description: Agent Skills, AGENTS.md, and Copilot settings from your project.

features.name: Code maps
features.description: GLOSSARY.md and SITE-MAP.md so agents find the right files first.

features.name: Opt-in telemetry and feedback
features.description: Off by default. Show, export, or delete your data anytime.

features.name: MCP server
features.description: Token counts, budgets, and Claude Code usage inside Claude Code.

features.name: CLI
features.description: The same tools in your terminal, with a live usage view.

architecture.purpose: Subscribes to editor events (active editor, tabs, edits, diagnostics), debounced at 300 ms, and builds a snapshot with pinned files and the active model.
Anthropic's open tokenizer for Claude (an approximation for current models), o200k_base via js-tiktoken for OpenAI, and about 4 characters per token for Gemini. Cached per document version.
Weights language match 0.25, imports 0.30, path similarity 0.20, edit recency 0.15, diagnostics 0.10. Pinned and active tabs score 1.
Input-only turn cost at catalog rates, including long-context thresholds. Output and cache hits are not observable from the editor.
Reads ~/.claude/projects logs for this workspace incrementally, dedupes by API message, counts human turns, and prices input, output, cache reads, and 5-minute and 1-hour cache writes.
@tokalator with 15 slash commands for counts, breakdowns, pins, models, compaction advice, previews, security, generators, and price watch.
A webview with keyed section updates, animated values, collapsible sections, keyboard support, and a nonce-locked content security policy.
Opt-in only and gated by VS Code's telemetry setting. Daily aggregates with restricted event names; export and delete commands.

tokenizers.models: Claude Fable, Mythos, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku
tokenizers.source: Approximate for Claude 3 and later; Claude Opus 4.7 and newer tokenize the same text into roughly 1.0 to 1.35 times as many tokens
Heuristic; Gemini's tokenizer is not published for local use

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.note: VS Code 1.99 or later. Paste into Quick Open (Cmd+P or Ctrl+P).

vsix.title: VSIX
steps: Build it: cd tokalator-extension-vs && npm install && npm run package
Command Palette: Extensions: Install from VSIX...

source.title: Build from source
source.command:
git clone https://github.com/vfaraji89/tokalator.git
cd tokalator/tokalator-extension-vs
npm install
npm run compile

cli.title: CLI
steps: cd tokalator/tokalator-mcp && npm install && npm run build
cli.command:
tokalator count src/main.ts
tokalator budget src/**/*.ts
tokalator preview 42000
tokalator models

mcp.title: MCP server (Claude Code)
mcp.note: Node.js 18 or later and Claude Code
steps: Register it with an absolute path to build/index.js
In Claude Code run /mcp and check that tokalator is listed
mcp.command: claude mcp add --transport stdio tokalator -- node "$PWD/build/index.js"
